clue.text: Rustic got through said examination

parts.note: to have got through something is to be past it
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A country student passing a spoken test.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastoral describes the countryside and rural life, so it is a synonym of rustic.

clue.text: In accordance with ticket having freedom to pick and choose

definitions.meaning: French ... means according to the card, the menu or ticket listing dishes

definitions.text: having freedom to pick and choose
definitions.meaning: ordering ... lets diners choose individual dishes rather than a set meal

explanation.surface: Someone whose ticket lets them choose whatever they like.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase literally means by the card, and in English describes a menu where each item is selected separately.

clue.text: Insensitive of daughter to support removing kitchen sink

indicators.note: in a down answer the letter for daughter goes underneath, propping up the rest
read as re-moving, the letters of kitchen sink are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A daughter helping out while the kitchen sink is being taken away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removing' is the anagram signal, read as moving again: KITCHENSINK becomes THICKSKINNE, with D placed below it, signalled by 'to support'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone thick-skinned is not easily hurt by criticism, so they are unfeeling or insensitive.

clue.text: Butter put on angler's stick

indicators.note: the first piece is placed on top of the second in this down answer

parts.note: read as one who butts, a ram butts with its head
an angler's equipment is a fishing rod

explanation.surface: A kitchen instruction to spread butter on a fisherman's pole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butter' is not the dairy spread but one who butts: a ram.
explanation.definitionFit: A ramrod is a rod used to push the charge into an old gun barrel, a kind of stick.

clue.text: Record old trademark, perhaps

parts.note: a log is a written record, as in a ship's log

explanation.surface: Registering an antique brand name.
explanation.definitionFit: A company emblem is a logo, and a trademark is one example of such an emblem.

clue.text: After the beginning was first taken aback

indicators.note: the second piece comes after the first in the answer

parts.note: the start is the beginning
someone who led was in front, first in the race

explanation.surface: A runner who took the lead after the start and was surprised.
explanation.definitionFit: To be startled is to be surprised or shocked, the same as being taken aback.

clue.text: Of course, one might contain one

definitions.text: Of course, one might contain one

parts.words: Of course, one might contain one
parts.note: the opening words sound like agreement but mean one course of a meal; the vessel serving it contains it

explanation.surface: A casual remark agreeing that something could hold something else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of course' reads as 'naturally', but the course is a part of a meal, served in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A course of food such as soup or dessert is served in a dish, the container that holds it.

clue.text: Way to encourage dealing with swimmer

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
to urge is to encourage
on means about or dealing with, as in a book on birds

explanation.surface: Advice on how to motivate someone who is busy with a swimmer.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish, the source of caviar, and fish are swimmers.

clue.text: One in rose-coloured spectacles?

parts.note: the idiom of seeing the world through rose-tinted glasses describes someone who always expects the best

explanation.surface: Someone wearing pink-tinted eyewear.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing things through rose-coloured spectacles is an idiom for cheerful hopefulness, the outlook of a person expecting good outcomes.

clue.text: Passenger vehicle returned at eleven

indicators.note: something returned goes back, so the word at is read backwards

parts.note: XI is eleven in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A bus or coach that came back at eleven o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab carries paying passengers, so it is a passenger vehicle.

clue.text: One likely to make the charts

definitions.text: One likely to make the charts

parts.words: One likely to make the charts
parts.note: sounds like a pop star bound for the hit parade, but means a person who draws maps and charts

explanation.surface: A singer tipped to have a hit record.
explanation.walkthrough: The charts sound like the pop music lists, but here they are maps.
explanation.definitionFit: A mapmaker draws maps and nautical charts, so making charts is the job itself.

clue.text: Why a report is unusually commendable

indicators.note: these letters are arranged in an unusual way, so they are reordered

explanation.surface: Asking why a school report is exceptionally favourable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deserving praise is worthy of commendation, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Used car repaired by Romeo for campaigner

indicators.note: something repaired is put back together, so these letters are reassembled

parts.note: Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A second-hand car fixed by a man called Romeo for an activist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repaired' reshapes USEDCAR into CRUSADE, with R added at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A crusader is someone fighting vigorously for a cause, a synonym of campaigner.

clue.text: Not even turbulent

definitions.meaning: ... water or a ... sea is turbulent

explanation.surface: Not even turbulent.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough means both bumpy, an irregular surface, and stormy or agitated, as of the sea.

clue.text: About three miles for union

definitions.meaning: an old measure of distance, roughly three miles

explanation.surface: A rough distance of three miles for a union.
explanation.definitionFit: A league is both an old unit of distance and an alliance of parties or teams, as in a football league.

clue.text: Some superior supernatural being

indicators.note: only some of the letters of superior are taken, a run from its middle

explanation.surface: A description of a higher, otherworldly creature.
explanation.definitionFit: In Persian mythology a peri is a fairy-like spirit, a supernatural being.

clue.text: Footwork

parts.note: normally nimble movement in sport or dance, but read literally as work done on the feet

explanation.definitionFit: A pedicure is cosmetic treatment of the feet and toenails, literally work on feet.

clue.text: Travelling? Sure!

definitions.meaning: ... for somewhere means heading there, on the way

explanation.definitionFit: Bound means heading towards a destination, as in homeward bound, and also certain, as in bound to win.

clue.text: Barely a suit for one's anniversary!

definitions.text: Barely a suit for one's anniversary!

parts.words: Barely a suit for one's anniversary!
parts.note: bareness is jokingly called wearing a suit named after the annual day of one's arrival in the world, so the clue points to that day

explanation.surface: A remark that hardly any outfit is worn to celebrate a yearly milestone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barely' hints at bareness: a birthday suit is jokey slang for being naked.
explanation.definitionFit: The day marking the anniversary of one's birth, whose name also gives the slang for naked skin.

clue.text: Notice group of bathers ignore

indicators.note: a small group of letters is taken from where the two words join

explanation.surface: A notice that a party of swimmers chooses to disregard.
explanation.definitionFit: A notice is a posted board giving information, which is a sign.

clue.text: Terrible danger with yours truly following one in uniform

indicators.note: the second piece follows the first
the letters are in a terrible mess, so they are rearranged

parts.note: yours truly is the setter speaking of themself, me

explanation.surface: Awful peril with me following someone in uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Terrible' is the anagram signal; 'yours truly' is the setter's way of saying me.
explanation.definitionFit: A gendarme is a French police officer, someone who wears a uniform.

clue.text: German article describing particular tranquilliser

indicators.note: describing is used in the sense of drawing around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: der is the German masculine word for the
own means particular to oneself, as in my own

explanation.surface: A German newspaper piece about a specific sedative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its geometric sense of drawing a line around something, as in describing a circle, so it signals one piece enclosing the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A downer is slang for a depressant drug, such as a sedative or tranquilliser.

clue.text: Blow that has to be faced

definitions.text: Blow that has to be faced

parts.words: Blow that has to be faced
parts.note: sounds like an unpleasant setback one must confront, but read literally as wind that blows in one's face

explanation.surface: A setback that one simply has to confront.
explanation.definitionFit: A wind blowing directly against the direction of travel strikes the traveller full in the face.

clue.text: An Arab vessel? Yes, certainly

parts.note: a dhow is a traditional sailing boat of the Arabian Sea

explanation.surface: Someone asked if a boat is Arabian and answering emphatically yes.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an emphatic exclamation of agreement, meaning very much so.

clue.text: Brush off as result of wearing a revealing dress?

definitions.meaning: to give someone the ... is to snub them

definitions.text: as result of wearing a revealing dress?
definitions.meaning: read literally, a bare shoulder in a skimpy dress might get chilly

explanation.definitionFit: To snub someone is to cold-shoulder them; a cold-shoulder dress also has cut-outs leaving the shoulders bare.

clue.text: See all right with this facial expression

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or behold
OK means all right

explanation.surface: Checking that a particular face is fine.
explanation.definitionFit: A look is the expression on someone's face, as in a puzzled look.

clue.text: Above using voucher with one-third off

indicators.note: the word has six letters, so a third of it, the first two, is cut away

parts.note: a coupon is a voucher

explanation.surface: Getting more by spending a discount voucher worth a third off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with one-third off' removes CO, two of the six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Upon means on top of, so it is a synonym of above in positional use.

clue.text: Exhaust that's found on car in America

definitions.text: that's found on car in America
definitions.meaning: the American spelling of tyre, the rubber on a wheel

explanation.surface: An exhaust pipe that is fitted on cars in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: To tire is to exhaust, and Americans spell the rubber wheel covering tire rather than the British tyre.

clue.text: Rising briefly, cheer Mexican banker

indicators.note: a word cut short loses its last letter

parts.note: a riot is an uprising, a rising
bravo is a cheer of applause

explanation.surface: A brief cheer rising for a Mexican financier.
explanation.walkthrough: A banker in crosswords is a river, having banks. The Rio Bravo is the Mexican name for the Rio Grande.
explanation.definitionFit: This river forms much of the border between Mexico and Texas, so it is a Mexican watercourse.

clue.text: One who has recently joined a union

definitions.text: One who has recently joined a union

parts.words: One who has recently joined a union
parts.note: sounds like a new trade union member, but the union is a marriage

explanation.surface: A new member of a trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: Marriage is a union, and someone just married has only lately joined one.
